name: clean-copy-of-folder
query: make me a cleaned copy of this export folder with the client names and any keys stripped before I share it
why: A sanitized copy of a folder is copy mode.

name: training-staging
query: run the staging folder through the scrubber before the fine-tune reads it and show me what was removed by class
why: Copy mode over a training staging folder with the counts-only report.

name: word-doc-before-llm
query: I want to paste this docx into a cloud model, strip anything identifying from it first
why: A Word document cleaned before any model sees it.

name: repo-pre-publish-scan
query: scan the repo for leftover identifiers, emails or secrets before I push the mirror, don't change anything
why: Tree mode: report only, exit 1 on hits.

name: extra-terms-this-run
query: redact these three project codenames and anything matching TCK-##### from the notes folder as well as the usual list
why: Per-run terms and patterns on top of the station list.

name: vault-answer-gate
query: before the vault answer goes back to the cloud agent, check it against the protected term list and withhold it if it hits
why: Answer mode on stdin, failing closed.

name: html-input-sanitizer
query: sanitize user input in the signup form so script tags can't get through
why: Web input sanitization is application code, not this engine.

name: git-history-rewrite
query: rewrite the git history to drop the commit that had the token in it
why: History rewriting is a git operation; the engine never edits history.

name: write-time-hook
query: why did the identifier hook flag my edit to the skill file just now
why: The write-time hook is its own tool; this skill is a batch copy and scan.

name: pdf-text-extraction
query: pull the text out of these PDFs into markdown
why: Extraction, not cleaning; PDFs are out of scope for this engine.

name: model-pii-masker
query: which local NER model should we use to mask names in transcripts
why: Picking an AI tool is the ai-engineering skill; the recall layer here is a later phase.

name: delete-the-file
query: delete the old exports folder, we don't need it anymore
why: A deletion is not a cleaned copy.
